spans.s: प्लक्ष m. 1. The Indian fig tree, प्लक्षप्ररोह इव सौधतलं बिभेद R.viii.93; 2. one of the seven continents of the world (in mythology); 3. a side-door, a private entrance.
प्लाक्ष n. A fruit of the Plaksha tree.
प्लक्ष-जाता, -समुद्रवाचका f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī.
प्लक्ष-जाता, -समुद्रवाचका f. an epithet of the river Sarasvatī.
प्लक्ष-तीर्थ, -प्रस्रवण न्।, -राज् म्। n. the place where the Sarasvatī takes its rise.
प्लक्ष-तीर्थ, -प्रस्रवण न्।, -राज् म्। n. the place where the Sarasvatī takes its rise.
प्लक्ष-राज् m. the place where the Sarasvatī takes its rise.
प्लव (I) a. (f. वा) 1. Swimming, floating; 2. jumping, leaping.

प्लव (II) m. 1. Swimming; 2. the swelling of a river; 3. a boat, a float, a raft, सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं संतरिष्यति Bg.iv.36, यथा प्लवेनौपलेन निमज्जत्युदके तरन् M.iv.194; 4. a snare for catching fish; 5. a frog; 6. a monkey; 7. a sheep; 8. the fig tree; 9. a Chaṇḍāla; 10. a declivity, a slope; 11. the kāraṇḍava bird; 12. five or more stanzas forming one sentence, (कुलक); 13. an enemy.
प्लव (I) a. (f. वा) 1. Swimming, floating; 2. jumping, leaping.
प्लाव m. 1. Flowing over; 2. jumping; 3. filtering, Yaj.i.190.
प्लव-ग n. 1. a monkey, an ape, R.xii.70; 2. a frog; 3. the diver (bird); 4. the Śirīshā plant; 5. a name of the charioteer of the sun.
प्लव-गा f. the sign Virgo of the zodiac.
प्लव-गति m. a frog.
प्लवंग m. 1. an ape, a monkey; 2. a deer; 3. the fig tree.
प्लवंगम m. 1. a frog; 2. a monkey.
प्लवक m. 1. A frog; 2. a tumbler, a rope-dancer; 3. a Chaṇḍāla; 4. the holy fig tree.
प्लवाका f. A boat, a raft.
प्लवन n. 1. Swimming; 2. jumping, leaping; 3. a deluge.
प्लावन n. 1. Bathing, ablution; 2. overflowing, flooding; 3. a flood, a deluge.
प्लविक a. (f. का) Taking over in a boat.
प्लविक a. (f. का) Taking over in a boat.
प्लावित a. (f. ता) 1. Made to float; 2. overflowed, deluged; 3. covered with; 4. moistened, wetted, Sis.xix.26.
प्लावित a. (f. ता) 1. Made to float; 2. overflowed, deluged; 3. covered with; 4. moistened, wetted, Sis.xix.26.
